scripts.dev: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('prisma/dev.db') || require('fs').statSync('prisma/dev.db').size === 0) { require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma db push --skip-generate && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }" && next dev -p 3000 -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.db:setup: prisma db push && prisma db seed
